mcqs.question: Which institution transmitted conventional data with entangled photons through the same 50-km optical fibre?
mcqs.explanation: IIT Delhi transmitted conventional data with entangled photons through the same 50-km optical fibre. SpaceX and RIDE! Space are associated with the TakeMe2Space launch arrangement, while the Department of Physics was the department led by Prof Bhaskar Kanseri.

mcqs.question: Which Indian spacetech company announced India’s first networked orbital data centre mission by the end of 2028?
mcqs.explanation: Indian spacetech company TakeMe2Space announced India’s first networked orbital data centre mission by the end of 2028. SpaceX is the Falcon 9 launch provider and RIDE! Space is the French firm involved in the launch-services pact, not the company announcing the mission.
